segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Sales of IFP Products, including cartridges, readers and accessories, in North and South America.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, management has concluded that the Company has four reportable segments consisting of the Americas, United Kingdom, APAC and Rest of World.

segments.name: United Kingdom
segments.description: Sales of IFP Products, including cartridges, readers and accessories, in England, Scotland, Northern Ireland and Wales.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, management has concluded that the Company has four reportable segments consisting of the Americas, United Kingdom, APAC and Rest of World.

segments.name: APAC
segments.description: Sales of IFP Products, including cartridges, readers and accessories, in South East Asia and Oceania.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, management has concluded that the Company has four reportable segments consisting of the Americas, United Kingdom, APAC and Rest of World.

segments.name: Rest of World
segments.description: Sales of IFP Products, including cartridges, readers and accessories, in all countries outside the other three segments.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, management has concluded that the Company has four reportable segments consisting of the Americas, United Kingdom, APAC and Rest of World.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for IFP Products, which include cartridges, readers and accessories.
revenueModel.evidence: Each reportable segment derives its revenues from the sale of the IFP Products which include cartridges, readers and accessories.
